;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Insurgency in Egypt (2013–present)]]
**Sixteen militants are killed in two different raids in [[Egypt]]'s [[Sinai Peninsula]]. A number of weapons and explosives are also found in the raids. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/egyptian-security-forces-kill-16-suspected-fighters-sinai-190219145158965.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019 Kaduna State massacre]]
**[[Kaduna State]] governor [[Nasir Ahmad el-Rufai|Nasir el-Rufai]] reports the death toll from Friday's attack in [[Kajuru]] is now more than 130,  most from the [[Fula people|Fulani]] ethnic group. [[Nigeria]]n authorities have not identified the gunmen's motive, but they do not believe the attack was related to [[2019 Nigerian general election|the upcoming election]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/02/death-toll-week-nigeria-attack-doubles-130-190219193655675.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://ewn.co.za/2019/02/19/death-toll-from-last-week-s-northwest-nigeria-attack-doubles-to-130 (Eyewitness news)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economy of the United States]]
**American retailer [[Payless ShoeSource]] files [[Chapter 11, Title 11, United States Code|Chapter 11 bankruptcy]] with plans to close all of their U.S. stores. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2019/02/19/payless-shoesource-chapter-11-bankruptcy/2913106002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Ford Motor Company]] will stop selling commercial trucks in [[South America]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/02/19/ford-will-stop-selling-commercial-trucks-in-south-america.html (CNBC)] 
*[[Honda]] confirms that it will be closing its car plant in [[Swindon]], South West England, because of decreased demand for diesel cars and tougher emissions regulations. The closure in 2021 will result in the loss of about 3,500 jobs. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-47287386 (BBC News)]
*[[Teva Pharmaceutical Industries|Teva Pharmaceutical]] settles outstanding cases with the [[Federal Trade Commission|U.S. Federal Trade Commission]] involving payments from brand-name drugmakers to delay releasing a cheaper version of its product, so-called [[Reverse payment patent settlement|"pay-for-delay" agreements]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ftc-teva-settlement/us-settles-with-teva-over-keeping-generic-drugs-off-market-idUSKCN1Q82U0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*An [[avalanche]] at the [[Crans-Montana]] [[ski resort]] in [[Switzerland]] injures four, one seriously, with fears that up to a dozen skiers may have been hit according to witnesses. 240 rescuers including police and army search the affected piste area.  No further victims are immediately found, or missing persons reported. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/at-least-a-dozen-skiers-may-be-buried-after-avalanche-hits-popular-swiss-alps-resort (Fox News)] [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/mountain-accident_crans-montana-avalanche-buries-skiers/44769096 (SwissInfo)]
*A house fire in [[Halifax, Nova Scotia|Halifax]], [[Nova Scotia]], [[Canada]], kills seven children from a [[Syria]]n family. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-47299551 (BBC News)]
*A father, his son, and a gas station employee are all killed in [[Wayne, New Jersey]] when a driver under the influence swerves his car and hits the father and son’s [[Chevrolet Camaro]]. [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/fatal-crash-impaired-driver-wayne-nj/42957/%3famp (NBC New York)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Bernie Sanders 2020 presidential campaign]]
***[[Vermont]] [[United States Senate|Senator]] and [[Bernie Sanders 2016 presidential campaign|2016 presidential candidate]] [[Bernie Sanders]] announces on [[Vermont Public Radio]] that he is running for [[President of the United States]] as a [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] in 2020. [https://www.npr.org/2019/02/19/676923000/bernie-sanders-enters-2020-presidential-campaign-no-longer-an-underdog?t=1550576496363 (NPR)]
*[[Politics of Spain]]
**[[Francisco José Alcaraz]], from [[Vox (Spanish political party)|Vox]], becomes the first far-right politician to become a [[Senate of Spain|Senator]] since the restoration of democracy. [https://www.elmundo.es/andalucia/2019/01/31/5c52df2ffc6c839b798b4652.html (''El Mundo'')]
*[[History of the Labour Party (UK)|History of the UK Labour Party]], [[Antisemitism in the UK Labour Party]]
**[[Joan Ryan]] becomes the eighth [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MP]] to quit the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] and join [[Change UK|The Independent Group]], citing a "culture of anti-Jewish racism" within the party as the reason for her departure. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-47300832 (BBC News)]

;Sports
*The opening round of the [[Aeroflot Open]], an international open [[chess]] tournament, is postponed a day after 45 minutes of play as a bomb threat locks down the [[Moscow]] hotel hosting the event. Similar threats also shut down cinemas, shopping centres, and theatres; thousands are evacuated. [https://www.chess.com/news/view/aeroflot-open-round-1-called-off-after-bomb-threat (Chess.com)] [https://en.chessbase.com/post/bomb-threats-in-moscow-round-1-of-the-aeroflot-open-was-aborted (Chessbase)]
